name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: An animated keycap for React and shadcn, pressing down when the real key does.

meta.details: A keycap that presses down when the real key does: the face drops 1px onto its base and springs back on release. Glyphs are announced by name; useKeysHeld lights up whatever a chord belongs to.

docs: Import Kbd and useKeysHeld from components/eased/kbd/kbd. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
